title: Concrete Kummer class at every positive finite level
statement: Fix $P$ as in [def-pur-conventions], with positive level $n$, finite coefficient ring $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$, and $m=\ell^n$. For a $k$-scheme $W$ use the finite twist $A(d)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], the roots sheaf of [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], and the projection-induced root tensor presentation of [lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free]. Thus $mA=0$, $m$ is invertible on $W$, and $A(1)=\mu_m\otimes_{\mathbf Z/m} A$. For a unit $u\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)^\times$, define its all-level finite Kummer class by the connecting map of the actual Kummer sequence [lem-amb-kummer-any-base], followed by the root scalar-extension unit of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class], $v\mapsto v\otimes1_A$, then the canonical cohomology comparison [lem-cbc-abelian-etale-proetale-cohomology-comparison] for the geometric morphism of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Equivalently, first form the etale module Ext class corresponding to $H^1(v\mapsto v\otimes1_A)(\delta_W(u))$, then apply exact comparison inverse image. No divisibility of $n$ by the ramification index is assumed. On every morphism of $k$-schemes, restriction of these positive finite twist sheaves is read via the canonical root-kernel and local pure-tensor normalized pullback isomorphisms of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Use the published normalized pullback wrapper of [thm-amb-p1-decomposition], which introduces no noetherian hypothesis for this helper.
